newEntriesNeeded.title: FINISH statement placement in error handlers
newEntriesNeeded.principle: FINISH should be placed inside the error handler block to stop macro execution after error logging.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Place FINISH inside handle/.../endhandle to halt on error. Do not rely on commented-out FINISH or place it after endhandle as dead code.
newEntriesNeeded.syntax:
LABEL /Error
handle any
  SAVEWORK
  UNCLAIM ALL
  -- error recovery actions
  FINISH
endhandle
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- Correct: FINISH inside error handler
LABEL /Error
handle any
  SAVEWORK
  !!logger.writeError('macro failed')
  FINISH
endhandle

-- Anti-pattern: FINISH as comment
--FINISH

-- Anti-pattern: FINISH after endhandle (unreachable)
endhandle
FINISH
pitfalls: FINISH inside handle block stops macro; FINISH after endhandle is unreachable if the handle block completes normally.
Commented-out FINISH (--FINISH) is silently ignored and does not stop macro on error.
newEntriesNeeded.sourcedoc: AVEVA PML Customization Guide - Macro Error Handling

newEntriesNeeded.title: String delimiters required in error handler function calls
newEntriesNeeded.principle: All string arguments to PML functions must use pipe delimiters (|text|) even inside error handlers.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Always wrap string literals in pipe delimiters in function call arguments, including in error handler blocks.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- Correct: pipe-delimited string argument
!!ramCommonLogger.writeErrorDataToExcel(|/project/output/log.xlsx|, false)

-- Anti-pattern: bare path without delimiters
!!ramCommonLogger.writeErrorDataToExcel(/project/output/log.xlsx, false)
pitfalls: Paths without string delimiters may parse as variable substitutions or cause syntax errors.
Error handlers are often written hastily and may omit delimiters that are present in main code.
